title: DotFantail16 font pack
description: 16px hex aesthetic font for Chinese & Japanese. 16px美術風點陣字型。
body:
# DotFantail16／點陣扇尾體16
Adds 16px Fantail font to the game. [Fantail](https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/ファンテール体) is a style of typeface featuring thin vertical strokes and thick horizontal strokes.  
新增16px的[扇尾體](https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/ファンテール体)字型，特點是豎細橫粗的筆畫。

This pack uses "FashionBitmap16" for Chinese Traditional and "KH Dot Kabutochou 16" for Japanese. Use the "Japanese Glyph Variants" option to switch between the two.  
使用「流行點陣體16」來顯示繁體中文，其上游「KHドット兜町16」來顯示日文。用「日文字形變體」選項來切換兩者。

Both original fonts are transformed to [`.hex` format](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/GNU_Unifont#.hex_format) for better rendering.  
兩字型皆已轉換為[`.hex`格式](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/GNU_Unifont#.hex_format)，避免ttf字型在Minecraft中的顯示問題。

Supplementary characters are added to cover in-game texts.  
含自製補字以涵蓋遊戲文本用字。

## Feature
* `unihex` font, no glitching for signs and bold text.
* Covers all in-game texts for `zh_tw`, `zh_hk`, and `ja_jp` (as of 26.1.2).

## Credit
Both original fonts are released under [SIL Open Font License 1.1](https://openfontlicense.org/).
* [KHドット兜町16](http://jikasei.me/font/kh-dotfont/) by 平木敬太郎, TrueType by 自家製フォント工房
* [流行點陣體16](https://github.com/scott0107000/FashionBitmap16) by Luke036, derived from KHドット兜町16
